subject: Post-call: Redwood inference + Hearthlight — next steps & vendor setup
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@hearthlight.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Redwood inference + Hearthlight — next steps & vendor setup

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the two asks we agreed on so nothing falls through the cracks:

- Goals: low-latency customer-facing PDF summarization (1–2s median) and enterprise-grade audit logs for compliance.
- Recommended config: Dedicated small pool (1x A10G equiv) for pilot, prefix/KV caching enabled; we proposed a 3-week POC.
- Milestones:
  1) Procurement paperwork & vendor onboarding (W-9 + ACH) — Hearthlight finance to complete vendor portal entry.
  2) Pilot kickoff — once vendor is set up we schedule infra onboarding and a short integration sprint.
  3) Metrics review — end of week 2 of pilot to tune batching/quantization.

Next steps (action owners):
- Daniel / Finance Team: complete vendor portal invite + upload W-9 and ACH details (we sent vendor instructions attached).
- Rishi (cc): will prepare pricing worksheet and updated SOW for your review.
- Me: I’ll coordinate the onboarding slot and share the Ops runbook + Redwood MA template.

Attachments: Redwood_MA_Template.pdf (demo SOW), W9_instructions.pdf (instructions for the vendor portal).

Can you confirm the Finance contact who will own the portal entry and an ETA this week or next?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise BDR | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

From: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@hearthlight.com>

Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference + Hearthlight — next steps & vendor setup

Thanks Vanessa — good call. I’ll own the internal side and loop finance. A couple quick items:

1) Who should the portal invite come from? (vendor name / tax name in the system)
2) Can you confirm the banking fields you need for ACH? We have an internal vendor verification step that asks for exact account name + routing format.

I’ll start the procurement request tomorrow morning and tag the finance queue. Tentative ETA: vendor entry by EOW next week (Jan 14).

— Daniel

Hi Hearthlight procurement team — looping you in to move vendor setup forward. I’m Rishi (AE on this deal). Per Vanessa’s thread, attached are the vendor instructions and a short SOW we plan to execute for the pilot.

What we need from you to complete onboarding:
- Completed vendor portal entry (legal entity name, EIN, billing contact)
- W-9 upload or equivalent tax form
- ACH details (account name, routing number) or confirmation you’ll accept check terms until ACH is verified

Attachments: Redwood_MA_Template.pdf, W9_instructions.pdf

If email is easier, please reply with the billing contact and the best phone number to reach them — I can run a quick verification call to speed things up. Our target remains to kick off the week after vendor activation.

Thanks,

Subject: Final nudge before rescheduling pilot — vendor setup status?

Hi Daniel / Hearthlight procurement — checking in one last time before we reassign the onboarding slot. We currently have a 60-minute Ops window reserved on Jan 31 for kick-off; if vendor activation isn’t complete by EOD Jan 27 we’ll need to move that to the following week.

If helpful, Redwood can: share a masked test account to validate connectivity before full vendor activation, or accept a provisional PO + check payment while ACH is being finalized. Both options reduce time-to-integration.

Please reply with one of the following by EOD Jan 27:
- "Portal completed" + confirmation of billing contact, or
- "Need provisional PO" and we’ll issue invoice terms, or
- New ETA for vendor activation.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 10-min call to unblock.

— Vanessa Ortiz
